before..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

# One run per push (docs/CI-HEALTH.md): a branch with an open pull request is built by the pull_request event only, so `push` is
# limited to main (the merge) and a branch without a pull request is not built until the person opens one or starts this workflow by hand.
# A documentation-only change skips this workflow; docs-gates.yml runs exactly then (its `paths` list equals the `paths-ignore` list
# below, tests/verify-ci-triggers.mjs checks that) so the suites that read the documents still run.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - '*.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'LICENSE'
      - 'NOTICE'
      - 'HUONG-DAN.txt'
      - 'VALIDATION.txt'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - '*.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'LICENSE'
      - 'NOTICE'
      - 'HUONG-DAN.txt'
      - 'VALIDATION.txt'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Keyed on the pull request number, so every push to one pull request replaces the run of the previous push; a push to main keys on
# its ref. Only pull request runs are cancelled: a run on main always finishes, so a red main is never hidden by a newer commit.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  hub-tests:
    name: Hub tests (${{ matrix.os }}, Node ${{ matrix.node }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        node: ['22', '24']
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: DATGOLD-HUB/tests/requirements-e2e.txt
      - name: Install pinned FastAPI E2E dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -r tests/requirements-e2e.txt
      - name: Configure Git identity for tests that create repositories
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "ci@example.invalid"
          git config --global user.name "ci"
      - name: Release source provenance regression
        run: python -m unittest discover -s ../scripts/tests -p test_release_source.py -v
      - name: Syntax check
        run: |
          for f in hub.mjs lib/*.mjs tests/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
      # --retry-failed-once runs a suite that failed a second time. One that passes then is FLAKY: never PASS, a ::warning annotation, a line in
      # the step summary and a count in summary.json (docs/CI-HEALTH.md). The run is still red for a suite that fails twice.
      - name: Run all suites
        run: node tests/run-all.mjs --no-skip all --retry-failed-once --json test-results/summary.json
      - name: Upload test summary
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: hub-test-summary-${{ matrix.os }}-node${{ matrix.node }}
          path: DATGOLD-HUB/test-results/summary.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  flaky-gate:
    # A retry hides one timing accident, not a habit: this fails a run of main when FLAKY suites showed up in this run and in the two runs of main
    # before it (scripts/ci-flaky-gate.mjs reads the hub-test-summary-* artifacts of those runs; it only reads GitHub). Not for pull requests.
    name: Flaky suites (3 runs of main in a row fail)
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.hub-tests.result == 'success' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: hub-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Download the summaries of this run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh run download "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern 'hub-test-summary-*' --dir flaky-current
      - name: Fail when the last three runs of main each needed a retry
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci-flaky-gate.mjs --current flaky-current --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --workflow CI --branch main --limit 3

  frontend-build:
    name: Frontend TypeScript / Vite build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB/ui
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: DATGOLD-HUB/ui/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Typecheck and production build
        run: npm run build
      - name: Upload built ChatMCP UI
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: chatmcp-ui-dist
          path: DATGOLD-HUB/web/dist
          if-no-files-found: error

  react-e2e:
    name: React / real Local Hub E2E (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB/ui
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: DATGOLD-HUB/ui/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Install headless Chromium and platform dependencies
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: React contract regression tests (no model API required)
        run: npm run test:unit
      - name: Build current React UI and run required E2E with a scripted provider
        run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: Upload React E2E results and failure traces
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: react-e2e-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: DATGOLD-HUB/ui/test-results
          if-no-files-found: error

  windows-installer:
    name: Windows installer build (self-contained)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@67a3573c9a986a3f9c594539f4ab511d57bb3ce9 # v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
      - name: Compile and run the required Windows HOST-only supervisor fixture
        env:
          CHATMCP_REQUIRE_HOST_SUPERVISOR: '1'
        run: |
          dotnet build DATGOLD-HUB/windows/sandbox/GuestSupervisor/GuestSupervisor.csproj --configuration Debug --nologo
          node DATGOLD-HUB/tests/windows-sandbox/smoke.mjs
      - name: Required installer payload and cleanup regression tests
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\tests\Test-InstallerPayload.ps1
      # The classes the installer, the uninstaller and the desktop shell compile from native-shared/ and installer/ (Hub health and ownership, the session file, the
      # install transaction and its rollback, the update lock, the link filter, the Windows PowerShell child), on the real Windows file system. Until this step only
      # the publish workflows ran them, so a pull request never showed their result.
      - name: Native lifecycle unit tests (shared Hub lifecycle, install transaction, Windows PowerShell child)
        run: dotnet run --project scripts/tests/native-lifecycle/NativeLifecycle.Tests.csproj --configuration Release
      - name: Stage the locked intelligence runtime (the files the installer ships) for the real language-server test
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd scripts/intelligence-runtime
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          node stage.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP/chatmcp-intelligence-runtime"
          node verify.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP/chatmcp-intelligence-runtime"
      # Without this step CI only ever ran the stub language server. CHATMCP_REQUIRE_REAL_LSP=1 makes a missing real server a failure
      # (the test would otherwise print a skip line and still pass); CHATMCP_LSP_NODE_MODULES makes the staged runtime the only place it looks.
      - name: Real TypeScript and Pyright language servers through the production seam (a skipped server fails)
        shell: bash
        env:
          CHATMCP_REQUIRE_REAL_LSP: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export CHATMCP_LSP_NODE_MODULES="$RUNNER_TEMP/chatmcp-intelligence-runtime/runtimes/lsp/node_modules"
          node DATGOLD-HUB/tests/verify-lsp-tier.mjs
      - name: Build fresh UI and Windows installer
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Build-Installer.ps1
      - name: Package Browser Companion and verify parity with installed payload
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Build-BrowserCompanion.ps1 -VerifyInstallerPayload
      - name: Required native WinForms / WebView2 smoke (current React + Local Hub)
        run: node DATGOLD-HUB/ui/e2e/webview2-smoke.mjs
      - name: Verify installer and checksum
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          if (-not (Test-Path .\dist\DatGoldSetup.exe)) { throw 'Installer was not created' }
          if (-not (Test-Path .\dist\DatGoldSetup.exe.sha256)) { throw 'Missing checksum' }
          $actual = (Get-FileHash .\dist\DatGoldSetup.exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          $expected = ((Get-Content .\dist\DatGoldSetup.exe.sha256 -Raw).Trim() -split '\s+')[0]
          if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw 'Installer checksum verification failed' }
          # The Companion is built under its new name and, as a copy, under the old one that every installed version links to.
          $extensionDigests = @()
          foreach ($extensionZip in @('.\dist\DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip', '.\dist\ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip')) {
            $extensionChecksum = "$extensionZip.sha256"
            if (-not (Test-Path $extensionZip) -or -not (Test-Path $extensionChecksum)) { throw "Companion ZIP or checksum missing: $extensionZip" }
            $extensionExpected = ((Get-Content $extensionChecksum -Raw).Trim() -split '\s+')[0].ToLowerInvariant()
            $extensionActual = (Get-FileHash $extensionZip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            if ($extensionActual -ne $extensionExpected) { throw "Companion ZIP checksum verification failed: $extensionZip" }
            $extensionDigests += $extensionActual
          }
          if (@($extensionDigests | Select-Object -Unique).Count -ne 1) { throw 'The Companion under its two names is not the same file' }
      - name: Upload Windows installer build
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: DatGoldSetup-win-x64
          path: |
            dist/DatGoldSetup.exe
            dist/DatGoldSetup.exe.sha256
            dist/DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip
            dist/DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip.sha256
            dist/ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip
            dist/ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error

  windows-upgrade-from-secretless-hub:
    # Releases up to v3.9.0 run a Hub without the per-launch secret. The installer preflight must still stop that Hub, then the
    # new Hub and the new shell must attach with the secret. Disposable hosted runner only (the lifecycle script refuses others).
    name: Windows upgrade from the published v3.9.0 (secretless Hub)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@67a3573c9a986a3f9c594539f4ab511d57bb3ce9 # v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
      - name: Installer preflight against the real v3.9.0 Hub from git
        run: node scripts/tests/legacy-hub-upgrade/run.mjs --baseline-ref 7f2551720fc65e95d1c2043adba7fde0dfececda
      - name: Build fresh UI and Windows installer
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Build-Installer.ps1
      # The baseline is a RELEASE ASSET that already exists: v3.9.0 published its installer as ChatMCPSetup.exe and that name cannot change.
      # The candidate built above is DatGoldSetup.exe.
      - name: Retrieve published hash-pinned upgrade baseline (v3.9.0)
        shell: powershell
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          gh release download v3.9.0 --repo $env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY --pattern ChatMCPSetup.exe --dir "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/native-baseline"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Baseline download failed' }
          if ((Get-FileHash "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/native-baseline/ChatMCPSetup.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne 'ef75e9a3721c5ba94a510de1ff00c1449031a4ac797570cb0d901861b509786e') { throw 'Baseline checksum mismatch' }
      - name: Real setup upgrade with the secretless v3.9.0 Hub running, then installed EXE lifecycle and uninstall
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/tests/Test-NativeLifecycle.ps1 -BaselineInstaller "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/native-baseline/ChatMCPSetup.exe" -CandidateInstaller dist/DatGoldSetup.exe -ExpectedBaselineVersion 3.9.0 -ExpectedCandidateVersion 3.11.1 -OutputDirectory "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/native-lifecycle-evidence"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Installed EXE acceptance failed' }
      - name: Native WebView2 smoke (shell attaches with the secret; new-window payload runs no script)
        run: node DATGOLD-HUB/ui/e2e/webview2-smoke.mjs
      - name: Upload lifecycle evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: native-lifecycle-evidence
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/native-lifecycle-evidence
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  windows-updater-e2e:
    # The in-app updater, seen working as a whole: a press of the mouse in the WebView2 window of an installed app (a trusted click that the browser takes for a person's, injected through the DevTools protocol:
    # not the operating system's mouse) downloads a signed update, the desktop shell checks it with its own C#, starts the setup in update mode (with its own pid in --wait-pid) and closes, and the setup replaces the files and opens
    # the new app; and the refusals (a tampered setup, a signature by another key, work that is running, a second request) leave the old app installed and working.
    # Test builds only: the setups are built from this commit with versions given at build time and a throwaway key list (nothing is committed, tagged, released or published), GitHub is a stand-in on a loopback
    # port, the key is made for the run. Not proved here, and said in the pull request: a release signed with the real key, GitHub itself, SmartScreen with an unsigned setup, a download of 230 MB over the internet.
    # Disposable hosted runner only (scripts/tests/updater-e2e/run.mjs refuses anything else). docs/DEVELOPMENT.md says what each phase proves.
    name: Windows in-app updater, end to end (real click, signed update)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 50
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@67a3573c9a986a3f9c594539f4ab511d57bb3ce9 # v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
      # Seconds, and first, so that a page the driver can no longer read (a test id that moved, a flow that changed) costs 20 seconds and not the 10 minutes of the builds: the same driver, against the Hub of
      # this tree and a headless Edge, with the desktop shell pretended (nothing is installed).
      - name: Rehearse the page driver against this tree's Hub and a headless Edge (no install, the shell is pretended)
        run: node scripts/tests/updater-e2e/rehearse-page.mjs --evidence "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e-evidence"
      # Then the one thing a runner can get wrong that nothing before it has tried: a debugging port that the WebView2 policy opens for a program of an ELEVATED account (a newer WebView2 ignores the
      # environment variable for one), with a real WebView2 window, a small stand-in host for the shell, and the same driver. It is the mechanism the job uses on the installed shell, in 30 seconds, and the host is started without the environment variable that WebView2 also reads, so only the policy can have opened the port.
      - name: Rehearse it against a real WebView2 window, its debugging port opened by the WebView2 policy (no install, a stand-in host)
        run: node scripts/tests/updater-e2e/rehearse-page.mjs --webview2 --policy --evidence "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e-evidence"
      - name: Throwaway signing keys of the run (scripts/new-release-key.mjs), outside the repository
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          node scripts/tests/updater-e2e/make-keys.mjs (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'updater-e2e-keys')
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'The throwaway keys could not be made.' }
      - name: Build an old and a newer setup of this commit, both trusting that key (test builds, nothing published)
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $current = [version](Get-Content DATGOLD-HUB/package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version
          $old = '{0}.{1}.{2}' -f $current.Major, $current.Minor, ($current.Build + 1)
          $new = '{0}.{1}.{2}' -f $current.Major, $current.Minor, ($current.Build + 2)
          powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/tests/updater-e2e/Build-TestPair.ps1 -Work (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'updater-e2e') -KeysFile (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'updater-e2e-keys\run-release-keys.json') -OldVersion $old -NewVersion $new -KeepWorkTrees
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'The two setups could not be built.' }
      - name: Install the old setup, update it from the page with presses of the mouse (trusted clicks), make the refusals happen
        run: node scripts/tests/updater-e2e/run.mjs --work "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e" --keys "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e-keys" --evidence "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e-evidence"
      - name: Upload the evidence of the proof
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: updater-e2e-evidence
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e-evidence
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-report.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-old.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-new.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-old.err.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-new.err.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  claims-map:
    # Claims-test rule (docs/CLAIMS.md): every headline claim is bound to a test that exercises the production path, or listed as unmapped,
    # and the number of unmapped claims may not grow. On a pull request the ratchet is also compared with the base branch.
    name: Claims map (unmapped count may not grow)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Claims map against the base branch
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        run: node tests/verify-claims-map.mjs --base "origin/$BASE_REF"
      - name: Claims map
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB
        run: node tests/verify-claims-map.mjs

  hygiene:
    name: Repository hygiene
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - name: No tracked file may match an ignore rule
        run: |
          tracked_ignored="$(git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard)"
          if [ -n "$tracked_ignored" ]; then
            echo "Tracked files that .gitignore says must not be committed:"
            echo "$tracked_ignored" | head -50
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: No bearer tokens or private keys in tracked files
        run: |
          if git grep -I -n -E 'Authorization"?[:=] *"?Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{24,}|-----BEGIN ([A-Z]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----' -- . ':(exclude)scripts/tests' ':(exclude)DATGOLD-HUB/tests' ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude).github'; then
            echo "A credential-looking value is tracked. Remove it and rotate the credential."
            exit 1
          fi

after..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

# One run per push (docs/CI-HEALTH.md): a branch with an open pull request is built by the pull_request event only, so `push` is
# limited to main (the merge) and a branch without a pull request is not built until the person opens one or starts this workflow by hand.
# A documentation-only change skips this workflow; docs-gates.yml runs exactly then (its `paths` list equals the `paths-ignore` list
# below, tests/verify-ci-triggers.mjs checks that) so the suites that read the documents still run.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - '*.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'LICENSE'
      - 'NOTICE'
      - 'HUONG-DAN.txt'
      - 'VALIDATION.txt'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - '*.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'LICENSE'
      - 'NOTICE'
      - 'HUONG-DAN.txt'
      - 'VALIDATION.txt'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Keyed on the pull request number, so every push to one pull request replaces the run of the previous push; a push to main keys on
# its ref. Only pull request runs are cancelled: a run on main always finishes, so a red main is never hidden by a newer commit.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  hub-tests:
    name: Hub tests (${{ matrix.os }}, Node ${{ matrix.node }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        node: ['22', '24']
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: DATGOLD-HUB/tests/requirements-e2e.txt
      - name: Install pinned FastAPI E2E dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -r tests/requirements-e2e.txt
      - name: Configure Git identity for tests that create repositories
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "ci@example.invalid"
          git config --global user.name "ci"
      - name: Release source provenance regression
        run: python -m unittest discover -s ../scripts/tests -p test_release_source.py -v
      - name: Syntax check
        run: |
          for f in hub.mjs lib/*.mjs tests/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
      # --retry-failed-once runs a suite that failed a second time. One that passes then is FLAKY: never PASS, a ::warning annotation, a line in
      # the step summary and a count in summary.json (docs/CI-HEALTH.md). The run is still red for a suite that fails twice.
      - name: Run all suites
        run: node tests/run-all.mjs --no-skip all --retry-failed-once --json test-results/summary.json
      - name: Upload test summary
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: hub-test-summary-${{ matrix.os }}-node${{ matrix.node }}
          path: DATGOLD-HUB/test-results/summary.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  flaky-gate:
    # A retry hides one timing accident, not a habit: this fails a run of main when FLAKY suites showed up in this run and in the two runs of main
    # before it (scripts/ci-flaky-gate.mjs reads the hub-test-summary-* artifacts of those runs; it only reads GitHub). Not for pull requests.
    name: Flaky suites (3 runs of main in a row fail)
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.hub-tests.result == 'success' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: hub-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Download the summaries of this run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh run download "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern 'hub-test-summary-*' --dir flaky-current
      - name: Fail when the last three runs of main each needed a retry
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci-flaky-gate.mjs --current flaky-current --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --workflow CI --branch main --limit 3

  frontend-build:
    name: Frontend TypeScript / Vite build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB/ui
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: DATGOLD-HUB/ui/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Typecheck and production build
        run: npm run build
      - name: Upload built ChatMCP UI
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: chatmcp-ui-dist
          path: DATGOLD-HUB/web/dist
          if-no-files-found: error

  react-e2e:
    name: React / real Local Hub E2E (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB/ui
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: DATGOLD-HUB/ui/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Install headless Chromium and platform dependencies
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: React contract regression tests (no model API required)
        run: npm run test:unit
      - name: Build current React UI and run required E2E with a scripted provider
        run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: Upload React E2E results and failure traces
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: react-e2e-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: DATGOLD-HUB/ui/test-results
          if-no-files-found: error

  windows-installer:
    name: Windows installer build (self-contained)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@67a3573c9a986a3f9c594539f4ab511d57bb3ce9 # v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
      - name: Compile and run the required Windows HOST-only supervisor fixture
        env:
          CHATMCP_REQUIRE_HOST_SUPERVISOR: '1'
        run: |
          dotnet build DATGOLD-HUB/windows/sandbox/GuestSupervisor/GuestSupervisor.csproj --configuration Debug --nologo
          node DATGOLD-HUB/tests/windows-sandbox/smoke.mjs
      - name: Required installer payload and cleanup regression tests
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\tests\Test-InstallerPayload.ps1
      # The classes the installer, the uninstaller and the desktop shell compile from native-shared/ and installer/ (Hub health and ownership, the session file, the
      # install transaction and its rollback, the update lock, the link filter, the Windows PowerShell child), on the real Windows file system. Until this step only
      # the publish workflows ran them, so a pull request never showed their result.
      - name: Native lifecycle unit tests (shared Hub lifecycle, install transaction, Windows PowerShell child)
        run: dotnet run --project scripts/tests/native-lifecycle/NativeLifecycle.Tests.csproj --configuration Release
      - name: Stage the locked intelligence runtime (the files the installer ships) for the real language-server test
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd scripts/intelligence-runtime
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          node stage.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP/chatmcp-intelligence-runtime"
          node verify.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP/chatmcp-intelligence-runtime"
      # Without this step CI only ever ran the stub language server. CHATMCP_REQUIRE_REAL_LSP=1 makes a missing real server a failure
      # (the test would otherwise print a skip line and still pass); CHATMCP_LSP_NODE_MODULES makes the staged runtime the only place it looks.
      - name: Real TypeScript and Pyright language servers through the production seam (a skipped server fails)
        shell: bash
        env:
          CHATMCP_REQUIRE_REAL_LSP: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export CHATMCP_LSP_NODE_MODULES="$RUNNER_TEMP/chatmcp-intelligence-runtime/runtimes/lsp/node_modules"
          node DATGOLD-HUB/tests/verify-lsp-tier.mjs
      - name: Build fresh UI and Windows installer
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Build-Installer.ps1
      - name: Package Browser Companion and verify parity with installed payload
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Build-BrowserCompanion.ps1 -VerifyInstallerPayload
      - name: Required native WinForms / WebView2 smoke (current React + Local Hub)
        run: node DATGOLD-HUB/ui/e2e/webview2-smoke.mjs
      - name: Verify installer and checksum
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          if (-not (Test-Path .\dist\DatGoldSetup.exe)) { throw 'Installer was not created' }
          if (-not (Test-Path .\dist\DatGoldSetup.exe.sha256)) { throw 'Missing checksum' }
          $actual = (Get-FileHash .\dist\DatGoldSetup.exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          $expected = ((Get-Content .\dist\DatGoldSetup.exe.sha256 -Raw).Trim() -split '\s+')[0]
          if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw 'Installer checksum verification failed' }
          # The Companion is built under its new name and, as a copy, under the old one that every installed version links to.
          $extensionDigests = @()
          foreach ($extensionZip in @('.\dist\DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip', '.\dist\ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip')) {
            $extensionChecksum = "$extensionZip.sha256"
            if (-not (Test-Path $extensionZip) -or -not (Test-Path $extensionChecksum)) { throw "Companion ZIP or checksum missing: $extensionZip" }
            $extensionExpected = ((Get-Content $extensionChecksum -Raw).Trim() -split '\s+')[0].ToLowerInvariant()
            $extensionActual = (Get-FileHash $extensionZip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            if ($extensionActual -ne $extensionExpected) { throw "Companion ZIP checksum verification failed: $extensionZip" }
            $extensionDigests += $extensionActual
          }
          if (@($extensionDigests | Select-Object -Unique).Count -ne 1) { throw 'The Companion under its two names is not the same file' }
      - name: Upload Windows installer build
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: DatGoldSetup-win-x64
          path: |
            dist/DatGoldSetup.exe
            dist/DatGoldSetup.exe.sha256
            dist/DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip
            dist/DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip.sha256
            dist/ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip
            dist/ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error

  windows-upgrade-from-secretless-hub:
    # Releases up to v3.9.0 run a Hub without the per-launch secret. The installer preflight must still stop that Hub, then the
    # new Hub and the new shell must attach with the secret. Disposable hosted runner only (the lifecycle script refuses others).
    name: Windows upgrade from the published v3.9.0 (secretless Hub)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@67a3573c9a986a3f9c594539f4ab511d57bb3ce9 # v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
      - name: Installer preflight against the real v3.9.0 Hub from git
        run: node scripts/tests/legacy-hub-upgrade/run.mjs --baseline-ref 7f2551720fc65e95d1c2043adba7fde0dfececda
      - name: Build fresh UI and Windows installer
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Build-Installer.ps1
      # The baseline is a RELEASE ASSET that already exists: v3.9.0 published its installer as ChatMCPSetup.exe and that name cannot change.
      # The candidate built above is DatGoldSetup.exe.
      - name: Retrieve published hash-pinned upgrade baseline (v3.9.0)
        shell: powershell
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          gh release download v3.9.0 --repo $env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY --pattern ChatMCPSetup.exe --dir "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/native-baseline"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Baseline download failed' }
          if ((Get-FileHash "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/native-baseline/ChatMCPSetup.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne 'ef75e9a3721c5ba94a510de1ff00c1449031a4ac797570cb0d901861b509786e') { throw 'Baseline checksum mismatch' }
      - name: Real setup upgrade with the secretless v3.9.0 Hub running, then installed EXE lifecycle and uninstall
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/tests/Test-NativeLifecycle.ps1 -BaselineInstaller "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/native-baseline/ChatMCPSetup.exe" -CandidateInstaller dist/DatGoldSetup.exe -ExpectedBaselineVersion 3.9.0 -ExpectedCandidateVersion 3.11.2 -OutputDirectory "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/native-lifecycle-evidence"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Installed EXE acceptance failed' }
      - name: Native WebView2 smoke (shell attaches with the secret; new-window payload runs no script)
        run: node DATGOLD-HUB/ui/e2e/webview2-smoke.mjs
      - name: Upload lifecycle evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: native-lifecycle-evidence
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/native-lifecycle-evidence
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  windows-updater-e2e:
    # The in-app updater, seen working as a whole: a press of the mouse in the WebView2 window of an installed app (a trusted click that the browser takes for a person's, injected through the DevTools protocol:
    # not the operating system's mouse) downloads a signed update, the desktop shell checks it with its own C#, starts the setup in update mode (with its own pid in --wait-pid) and closes, and the setup replaces the files and opens
    # the new app; and the refusals (a tampered setup, a signature by another key, work that is running, a second request) leave the old app installed and working.
    # Test builds only: the setups are built from this commit with versions given at build time and a throwaway key list (nothing is committed, tagged, released or published), GitHub is a stand-in on a loopback
    # port, the key is made for the run. Not proved here, and said in the pull request: a release signed with the real key, GitHub itself, SmartScreen with an unsigned setup, a download of 230 MB over the internet.
    # Disposable hosted runner only (scripts/tests/updater-e2e/run.mjs refuses anything else). docs/DEVELOPMENT.md says what each phase proves.
    name: Windows in-app updater, end to end (real click, signed update)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 50
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@67a3573c9a986a3f9c594539f4ab511d57bb3ce9 # v4.3.1
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
      # Seconds, and first, so that a page the driver can no longer read (a test id that moved, a flow that changed) costs 20 seconds and not the 10 minutes of the builds: the same driver, against the Hub of
      # this tree and a headless Edge, with the desktop shell pretended (nothing is installed).
      - name: Rehearse the page driver against this tree's Hub and a headless Edge (no install, the shell is pretended)
        run: node scripts/tests/updater-e2e/rehearse-page.mjs --evidence "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e-evidence"
      # Then the one thing a runner can get wrong that nothing before it has tried: a debugging port that the WebView2 policy opens for a program of an ELEVATED account (a newer WebView2 ignores the
      # environment variable for one), with a real WebView2 window, a small stand-in host for the shell, and the same driver. It is the mechanism the job uses on the installed shell, in 30 seconds, and the host is started without the environment variable that WebView2 also reads, so only the policy can have opened the port.
      - name: Rehearse it against a real WebView2 window, its debugging port opened by the WebView2 policy (no install, a stand-in host)
        run: node scripts/tests/updater-e2e/rehearse-page.mjs --webview2 --policy --evidence "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e-evidence"
      - name: Throwaway signing keys of the run (scripts/new-release-key.mjs), outside the repository
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          node scripts/tests/updater-e2e/make-keys.mjs (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'updater-e2e-keys')
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'The throwaway keys could not be made.' }
      - name: Build an old and a newer setup of this commit, both trusting that key (test builds, nothing published)
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $current = [version](Get-Content DATGOLD-HUB/package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version
          $old = '{0}.{1}.{2}' -f $current.Major, $current.Minor, ($current.Build + 1)
          $new = '{0}.{1}.{2}' -f $current.Major, $current.Minor, ($current.Build + 2)
          powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/tests/updater-e2e/Build-TestPair.ps1 -Work (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'updater-e2e') -KeysFile (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'updater-e2e-keys\run-release-keys.json') -OldVersion $old -NewVersion $new -KeepWorkTrees
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'The two setups could not be built.' }
      - name: Install the old setup, update it from the page with presses of the mouse (trusted clicks), make the refusals happen
        run: node scripts/tests/updater-e2e/run.mjs --work "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e" --keys "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e-keys" --evidence "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/updater-e2e-evidence"
      - name: Upload the evidence of the proof
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: updater-e2e-evidence
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e-evidence
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-report.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-old.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-new.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-old.err.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/updater-e2e/build-new.err.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  claims-map:
    # Claims-test rule (docs/CLAIMS.md): every headline claim is bound to a test that exercises the production path, or listed as unmapped,
    # and the number of unmapped claims may not grow. On a pull request the ratchet is also compared with the base branch.
    name: Claims map (unmapped count may not grow)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Claims map against the base branch
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        run: node tests/verify-claims-map.mjs --base "origin/$BASE_REF"
      - name: Claims map
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB
        run: node tests/verify-claims-map.mjs

  hygiene:
    name: Repository hygiene
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - name: No tracked file may match an ignore rule
        run: |
          tracked_ignored="$(git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard)"
          if [ -n "$tracked_ignored" ]; then
            echo "Tracked files that .gitignore says must not be committed:"
            echo "$tracked_ignored" | head -50
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: No bearer tokens or private keys in tracked files
        run: |
          if git grep -I -n -E 'Authorization"?[:=] *"?Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{24,}|-----BEGIN ([A-Z]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----' -- . ':(exclude)scripts/tests' ':(exclude)DATGOLD-HUB/tests' ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude).github'; then
            echo "A credential-looking value is tracked. Remove it and rotate the credential."
            exit 1
          fi

cases.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/publish-v3.11.2.yml b/.github/workflows/publish-v3.11.2.yml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..af92a2c2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/publish-v3.11.2.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,214 @@
+# Publish only the user-authorized release commit. All gates use that exact SHA.
+# v3.11.2 is a normal release: it is published as the "latest" release, after the same gates as v3.11.1. The downloads are DatGoldSetup.exe and DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip. The signature of RELEASE-MANIFEST.json is added by hand afterwards.
+name: Publish ChatMCP v3.11.2
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: publish-chatmcp-v3.11.2-${{ github.sha }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  browser:
+    name: Real Chromium MV3 delivery gate
+    if: >-
+      ${{ startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'release: ChatMCP v3.11.2') }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
+        with:
+          node-version: '24'
+      - name: Run actual extension IPC on scripted pages, without live login
+        working-directory: DATGOLD-HUB/ui
+        env:
+          PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/companion-release-evidence/results.json

diff --git a/RELEASE-NOTES-v3.11.2.md b/RELEASE-NOTES-v3.11.2.md
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..2b6eb9e3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/RELEASE-NOTES-v3.11.2.md
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+# DatGold v3.11.2 — more skills install, review receipts that hold and the Hub side of per-hunk review
+
+This is a normal release and is published as the latest release. It contains everything of v3.11.1 and what was merged after it (pull requests 92 to 95). It is the first release that an installed v3.11.1 can offer through the **Update button**.
+
+## What changed since v3.11.1
+
+**More skills of the catalogs install.** Pressing Install on `claude-api` in Settings → Kỹ năng (catalog `anthropics/skills`) stopped with "Unsupported or malformed SKILL.md YAML on line 3". The skill's file starts its description with `description: |-`, a YAML block scalar with a chomping indicator, and the Hub's small YAML reader only knew `|` and `>`. It now reads `|`, `>` with an optional `-` or `+` and an optional indentation digit (`|-`, `|+`, `|2`, `>-`), and keeps refusing everything else it does not understand. `claude-api` and nine skills of `github/awesome-copilot` can be installed now. **8 of the 549 skills that the five catalogs list still cannot be read** (2 of `vercel-labs/agent-skills`, 6 of `github/awesome-copilot`). The error now names the skill, the key and the line of the file (the first `---` is line 1; before, it counted from the line after it). A manual, read-only script, `node DATGOLD-HUB/tests/live/check-skill-manifests.mjs --source all`, reads every `SKILL.md` that the Skills card lists and says which ones cannot be read and why; CI never runs it.
+
+**A real `git_diff` leaves its review receipt, and receipts go stale when they should.** The Hub looked for a `diff` field in the result of `git_diff` that the real tool never returned, so a real coding run could not have a review receipt. The tool now returns the digest of a diff that is whole and not empty, and the Hub makes the receipt from it. A receipt also goes stale after every tool that can change the files: `move_path`, `delete_path`, `git_checkout`, `git_merge`, adding or removing a worktree and switching branches (a tool called through `mcp_call` is judged by the name it ran under). Before, the list that did this named `move_file` and `delete_file` where the Hub's tools are called `move_path` and `delete_path`, so a move or a delete after a passing check or a review cleared nothing. **Accepting the objective is still yours**; this changes which receipts the Hub can offer you.
+
+**The Hub side of per-hunk review (no screen uses it yet).** Tool events carry `callId`, a bounded `input` (paths or the command, never the text of a file) and, when the guard made one for that call, `checkpointId`. `GET /api/studio/task-review?taskId=` lists the files a task changed, each against the first checkpoint of the task, and `POST /api/studio/review/reject-created` moves a file that the task created to the undo folder, after a verified copy. The text save of the Studio keeps the BOM and the line endings of the file and takes up to 300,000 bytes. The contract is in [docs/REVIEW-API.md](docs/REVIEW-API.md).
+
+**A file that is not UTF-8 is no longer opened for editing.** `GET /api/studio/file` answers 415 `not_utf8` for a file that would not go back to the same bytes (a Windows-1252 text, for instance). It used to open, and saving replaced the file with the editor's text. The Files tab cannot open such a file any more.
+
+**Downloads.** `DatGoldSetup.exe` and `DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip` (each with its `.sha256`) and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` with its signature, as in v3.11.1.
+
+## Upgrade
+
+**From v3.11.0 or v3.11.1:** Settings → Updates → Check now. When it shows 3.11.2 with a valid signature, press Download; when the download is checked, press **Install and restart** in the desktop app.
+**From v3.10.x or older:** install by hand, once. Download `DatGoldSetup.exe` and its `.sha256` file, compare the digest with `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json`, close DatGold, stop active tasks and install over your version. Copies installed from older builds were made without the keys that sign releases, so their apps cannot check a signature.
+
+The Browser Companion is a separately installed extension; its version stays **1.5.2**.
+
+The Hub's health version is `3.11.2` and the UI build identifier is `3.11.2-react-agent`.
+
+## What to try
+
+- Settings → Kỹ năng → catalog `anthropics/skills` → Install `claude-api`. If another skill still fails, the message says which key of its front matter.
+- Ask the agent to change a file and then to show the diff: the proof strip should list a review receipt that comes from the diff. Edit the file again, or move or delete a file, and the receipt should be stale.
+- Open a text file that is not UTF-8 (an old Windows-1252 file) in the Files tab and see that it is refused instead of opened.
+- Update from v3.11.1 with the button, and tell us what happened.
+
+## What is not verified
+
+- **The Update button is verified only on a hosted runner.** v3.11.0 and v3.11.1 were signed with the project's real key and read back from GitHub by the Hub's own code, and a CI job drives the click on a hosted Windows runner with a stand-in for GitHub and a key made for the run. A click on a real machine against the real GitHub is for the first person who tries and tells us.
+- **The new error message of the Skills card was not seen in the running app.** The Hub's code that raises it, and the code of the card that shows it, were read; no run pressed Install on a skill that cannot be read. The live script reads the files of the catalogs; it installs nothing.
+- **The review API has no screen yet.** It is tested by the Hub's own tests and mutation lists only, not by a person clicking.
+- A coding run can now carry a review receipt from the real `git_diff`. No test with a real model shows a run that ends "ready" with it.
+- Compaction, the Hub-accepts-checks switch and the other changes of v3.11.1 are as described in its notes: tested with a scripted model, not shown to do better with a real one.
+- Windows may ask for confirmation, or block, a setup that is not Authenticode-signed (SmartScreen, Smart App Control); the installer is not signed and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` says so.
+- No automated test calls a live provider, and no signed-in Edge/ChatGPT session was tried.
+
+## How it was built
+
+It is published by a copy of the v3.11.1 release workflow, which refuses to publish unless the full regression on the exact release commit, the installer build, the installed upgrade from the published v3.9.0, the WebView2 smoke test, the release gate and the asset checksums have all passed. The signature of `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` is made by hand with the project's release key after the workflow has finished and is added to the release afterwards, so until it is there an app only announces the release. See [Security](SECURITY.md) and [the upgrade checkpoint](docs/UPGRADE-IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md).

<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>WinExe</OutputType>

# ChatMCP upgrade implementation checkpoint

# DatGold v3.11.1 — skills chosen from the project, bigger attachments and a compaction you can tune

This is a normal release and is published as the latest release. It contains everything of v3.11.0 and what was merged after it. It is the first release that an installed v3.11.0 can offer through the **Update button**.

## What changed since v3.11.0

**Compaction you can tune, and a check of what it kept.** Settings → Dự án → Tác tử has the percent of its history budget from which the agent compacts the conversation: a whole number from 50 to 95, **80 when you choose none**. From that point the Hub shortens the copy of old tool results and replaces the oldest part with a checkpoint built from its own record of the task (your requests, the files looked at or changed, the latest failing command that was not fixed since, the pictures that left the request), not from the model's recent words. After each compaction the activity log says `Kiểm tra giữ lại thông tin: n/m` and names anything that did not make it into the request. The Hub always keeps the three newest call/result pairs whole, so at a low percent, a small window and very large results there may be no safe place to cut: it says so and deletes nothing. The choice is read at every model request, so it applies to a conversation that is already open.

**The Hub can accept the checks it ran — only if you turn it on.** The same card has a switch, **off by default**: with it on, a criterion of the objective acceptance panel that asks for a check is matched by the Hub to the latest passing check it ran and recorded, once the objective before it is accepted. This **relaxes the promise that only you accept**, for checks only: the evidence says `acceptedBy: auto_hub_check`, the panel tags the criterion ("Hub tự chấp nhận") and you can press Confirm to replace it with your own acceptance; "observed" and "edited" stay yours. A passing check only says that a command exited with 0.

**Objective acceptance is quicker to read.** Each criterion shows the latest receipt of the kind it needs already chosen, and one button confirms the whole plan in the order the Hub needs. You still read and confirm; nothing is accepted for you.

**Skills are chosen from the project, and the model can read the rest.** The selector reads Vietnamese phrases as well as English ones and takes the kind of project into account (from the names of the files in its root and the dependencies it declares). The skill index now also names every enabled skill, so the model can read one on demand with `skill_load` when none was preloaded. A manual script, `DATGOLD-HUB/tests/live/skill-load-live.mjs`, asks a real model a question about a custom skill and reports whether it read the skill; it costs money and is never run by CI.

**Attachments up to what the providers accept.** A message takes up to 10 files, 3.75 MiB per picture, 12 MiB in all and text files up to 200,000 bytes; a bigger file gets a notice that points to the project folder route. The page fits a picture that is too large before it is sent. A picture used to be dropped without a word from a long conversation, because the size estimate counted its base64 as text; each picture now counts as a fixed number of tokens, and when pictures do leave a request the model and you are told how many.

**Models and providers.** A Kimi preset; models that a provider has deprecated are hidden in the picker; the catalog snapshot is dated 2026-10-28 and a weekly workflow proposes a refreshed one as a draft pull request (it can open one only after the repository setting that lets Actions open pull requests is turned on, which it is not today; the Hub itself still refreshes only when you press the button); the default model of the Groq preset is `openai/gpt-oss-120b`.

**Smaller things.** "View evidence" on the banner of a failed turn opens the evidence; the top bar shows the new gold D mark; the source folder is `DATGOLD-HUB` (an installation keeps its `CHATMCP-HUB` folder, see [docs/NAMING.md](docs/NAMING.md)).

**The Hub folder inside an installation is `DATGOLD-HUB`.** Up to 3.11.0 it was `CHATMCP-HUB` (the repository already used the new name). The setup of this version installs the new folder, removes the files of the old one that the earlier setup put there (a file you changed stays) together with the folders left empty, and still recognises, and stops, the Hub that an installation of 3.11.0 or older started. **If you loaded the Browser Companion into Chrome or Edge straight from `CHATMCP-HUB\extension`, it stops working after the update** (the folder is gone): load it again from `DATGOLD-HUB\extension`, or from the extracted `DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip`. Your settings and history are not in that folder and are not touched.

**Downloads.** A release now carries `DatGoldSetup.exe` and `DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip` (each with its `.sha256`) and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` with its signature. **`ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip` is no longer published.** An app of v3.10.x or older links to that name from its "download the Companion" button, which answers 404 until that copy is replaced by v3.11.0 or later.

## Upgrade

**From v3.11.0:** Settings → Updates → Check now. When it shows 3.11.1 with a valid signature, press Download; when the download is checked, press **Install and restart** in the desktop app. This is the first time the button is used on a real release.

**From v3.10.x or older:** install by hand, once. Download `DatGoldSetup.exe` and its `.sha256` file, compare the digest with `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json`, close DatGold, stop active tasks and install over your version. Copies installed from older builds were made without the keys that sign releases, so their apps cannot check a signature.

The Browser Companion is a separately installed extension; its version stays **1.5.2**.

The Hub's health version is `3.11.1` and the UI build identifier is `3.11.1-react-agent`.

## What to try

- After the update the folder `CHATMCP-HUB` is no longer in the installation folder, and `DATGOLD-HUB` is. If a browser had the Companion loaded from the old folder, load it again.
- Settings → Dự án → Tác tử: choose 70, send a long task and look at the activity log for `Kiểm tra giữ lại thông tin`.
- Leave the Hub-accepts-checks switch off and check that the acceptance panel shows no tag; turn it on, run a task that ends with a passing check, accept the first objective yourself and see the tag on the check of the next.
- Ask a question in Vietnamese in a project with a `package.json` and look at the line under the turn that says which skills were selected.

## What is not verified

- **The move of the Hub folder** was run by the CI job that installs the published v3.9.0 (folder `CHATMCP-HUB`), starts its Hub, and upgrades it with the setup of this build; that the Update button does the same from a v3.11.0 on a real machine is the thing nobody has seen yet.
- **The Update button has not yet been used on a real release.** v3.11.0 was signed with the project's real key and its signature was read back from GitHub by the Hub's own code, and a CI job drives the click on a hosted Windows runner with a stand-in for GitHub and a key made for the run. This release is the first that a v3.11.0 installed on a real machine can be updated to; whether it works there is for the first person who tries.
- The compaction was tested with a scripted model. No test shows that a real model does better after a compaction, and the retention check shows that the Hub's facts are in the request, not that the model uses them.
- **With the Hub-accepts-checks switch on, a check that passes proves little**: the model chooses the command, and an empty test suite exits with 0.
- With the real tools a coding plan cannot reach a "ready" completion: the `git_diff` tool leaves no receipt that the Hub accepts as a review of the diff, so every coding run still ends with "No independently recorded Git diff review". This is known and is not changed here.
- Windows may ask for confirmation, or block, a setup that is not Authenticode-signed (SmartScreen, Smart App Control); the installer is not signed and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` says so.
- No automated test calls a live provider, and no signed-in Edge/ChatGPT session was tried.

## How it was built

It is published by a copy of the v3.11.0 release workflow, which refuses to publish unless the full regression on the exact release commit, the installer build, the installed upgrade from the published v3.9.0, the WebView2 smoke test, the release gate and the asset checksums have all passed. The signature of `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` is made by hand with the project's release key after the workflow has finished and is added to the release afterwards, so until it is there an app only announces the release. See [Security](SECURITY.md) and [the upgrade checkpoint](docs/UPGRADE-IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md).

The setup of this version renames the old folder in one step, after it stopped the Hub, and then replaces in it what changed, like in any other update; if Windows refuses the rename (a program has a file of the folder open), it goes file by file instead: it installs the new folder, removes the files of the old one that the earlier setup put there (a file you changed stays) together with the folders left empty. It still recognises, and stops, the Hub that an installation of 3.11.0 or older started. **If you loaded the Browser Companion into Chrome or Edge straight from `CHATMCP-HUB\extension`, it stops working after the update** (the folder is gone): load it again from `DATGOLD-HUB\extension`, or from the extracted `DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip`. Your settings and history are not in that folder and are not touched.

**Downloads.** A release now carries `DatGoldSetup.exe` and `DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip` (each with its `.sha256`) and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` with its signature. **`ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip` is no longer published.** An app of v3.10.x or older links to that name from its "download the Companion" button, which answers 404 until that copy is replaced by v3.11.0 or later.

## Upgrade

**From v3.11.0:** Settings → Updates → Check now. When it shows 3.11.1 with a valid signature, press Download; when the download is checked, press **Install and restart** in the desktop app. This is the first time the button is used on a real release.

**From v3.10.x or older:** install by hand, once. Download `DatGoldSetup.exe` and its `.sha256` file, compare the digest with `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json`, close DatGold, stop active tasks and install over your version. Copies installed from older builds were made without the keys that sign releases, so their apps cannot check a signature.

The Browser Companion is a separately installed extension; its version stays **1.5.2**.

The Hub's health version is `3.11.1` and the UI build identifier is `3.11.1-react-agent`.

## What to try

- After the update the folder `CHATMCP-HUB` is no longer in the installation folder, and `DATGOLD-HUB` is. If a browser had the Companion loaded from the old folder, load it again.
- Settings → Dự án → Tác tử: choose 70, send a long task and look at the activity log for `Kiểm tra giữ lại thông tin`.
- Leave the Hub-accepts-checks switch off and check that the acceptance panel shows no tag; turn it on, run a task that ends with a passing check, accept the first objective yourself and see the tag on the check of the next.
- Ask a question in Vietnamese in a project with a `package.json` and look at the line under the turn that says which skills were selected.

## What is not verified

- **The move of the Hub folder** was run by the CI job that installs the published v3.9.0 (folder `CHATMCP-HUB`), starts its Hub, and upgrades it with the setup of this build; that the Update button does the same from a v3.11.0 on a real machine is the thing nobody has seen yet.
- **The Update button has not yet been used on a real release.** v3.11.0 was signed with the project's real key and its signature was read back from GitHub by the Hub's own code, and a CI job drives the click on a hosted Windows runner with a stand-in for GitHub and a key made for the run. This release is the first that a v3.11.0 installed on a real machine can be updated to; whether it works there is for the first person who tries.
- The compaction was tested with a scripted model. No test shows that a real model does better after a compaction, and the retention check shows that the Hub's facts are in the request, not that the model uses them.
- **With the Hub-accepts-checks switch on, a check that passes proves little**: the model chooses the command, and an empty test suite exits with 0.
- With the real tools a coding plan cannot reach a "ready" completion: the `git_diff` tool leaves no receipt that the Hub accepts as a review of the diff, so every coding run still ends with "No independently recorded Git diff review". This is known and is not changed here.
- Windows may ask for confirmation, or block, a setup that is not Authenticode-signed (SmartScreen, Smart App Control); the installer is not signed and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` says so.
- No automated test calls a live provider, and no signed-in Edge/ChatGPT session was tried.

## How it was built

It is published by a copy of the v3.11.0 release workflow, which refuses to publish unless the full regression on the exact release commit, the installer build, the installed upgrade from the published v3.9.0, the WebView2 smoke test, the release gate and the asset checksums have all passed. The signature of `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` is made by hand with the project's release key after the workflow has finished and is added to the release afterwards, so until it is there an app only announces the release. See [Security](SECURITY.md) and [the upgrade checkpoint](docs/UPGRADE-IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md).

# Naming: DatGold, formerly ChatMCP

The product is called **DatGold**. It was called ChatMCP until 2026-10-24. Releases up to 3.9.0 were published under the old name and stay available under it.

The change was made in two steps so that nothing a person already has stops working:

1. **The name people read** (done). Every screen, message, window title, document and the Browser Companion say DatGold, and so do the setup and uninstall wizard and the shortcuts and the Apps & features entry they make (2026-10-25).
2. **The identifiers** (not done). Names that other programs, scripts, stored data or an upgrade depend on keep the old spelling until each can change with an alias or a migration. The table below lists them; nothing in it is an oversight.

The legal name of the copyright holder did not change: **Phan Danh Dat** (see [NOTICE](../NOTICE)).

## What says DatGold

- The React UI, in Vietnamese and in English (screens, dialogs, toasts, confirmations), and the title of the page.
- The title and status texts of the desktop window, and the product, company and description fields of the application file.
- The setup wizard and the uninstaller (title, header, every text, the file properties of the setup file), the shortcuts they make (Desktop `DatGold Studio`, Start menu folder `DatGold`) and the entry in Apps & features (`DatGold Studio`). Setup also removes the shortcuts that versions up to 3.10.1 made under the old name, and the uninstaller removes both sets (see below).
- The files you download from a release: `DatGoldSetup.exe` with its `.sha256`, and `DatGold-Browser-Companion.zip` (from the first release after 3.10.2). Releases up to 3.10.2 published `ChatMCPSetup.exe` and `ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip` and keep those file names; every later release also publishes the Companion under the old name, as a copy (see the table). The setup file inside is built as `DatGoldSetup.exe`, so its properties, and those of the `Uninstall.exe` that it copies, name DatGold; setup still recognises an `Uninstall.exe` of an earlier version by its old names (`IsOwnVersionInfo` in `installer/InstallerEngine.cs`).
- The icon: a gold D on a dark rounded square, drawn by `scripts/generate-brand-icon.py` without a font. It is the icon of the application, the setup file, the shortcuts, the Apps & features entry and the browser tab (the files keep their old names: `assets/icons/chatmcp.ico`, `DATGOLD-HUB/web/favicon.ico`).
- The Browser Companion: the name Chrome and Edge show (`DatGold Hub Companion`), its button, popup and instructions.
- The messages and sentences the Hub writes for a person: the sign-in and pairing errors, the Windows Sandbox probe, the verification and hook notes at the end of an answer, the "withheld" notice for a protected file, the header of the exported ChatGPT-web transcript, the names of the files it offers to save, the authors of the built-in skills, the hooks schema.
- The README, NOTICE, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, the third-party notices and the living documents in `docs/` and `design/`.

`DATGOLD-HUB/tests/verify-display-name.mjs` reads those places and fails for any ChatMCP that is not one of the exceptions below, so the old name cannot come back unnoticed.

## What still says ChatMCP, and why

| Where | What | Why it stays | Changes with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Repository and releases | `github.com/pddczpl/ChatMCP`, the release workflows, the file names of releases up to 3.10.2 (`ChatMCPSetup.exe`, `ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip`), and `ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip` as a copy of the Companion in every later release | A published file cannot be renamed; the upgrade test downloads the published 3.9.0 as `ChatMCPSetup.exe`; every installed version links to `releases/latest/download/ChatMCP-Browser-Companion.zip`, so a release without that file would break the link in the app | The release pipeline step (P5); the copy can go when no supported version links to it |
| Installer and installed program | `ChatMCP.exe`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ChatMCP`, the registry key `...\Uninstall\ChatMCP`, and the update folder `.ChatMCP-update-*`. (The Hub folder inside the installation is `DATGOLD-HUB\`, as in the repository. Installations made up to 3.11.0 called it `CHATMCP-HUB\`: the setup of a newer version still recognises the Hub that such an installation started, removes the files it put there and the folders that are left empty, and keeps any file that somebody changed.) | The installer finds, replaces and removes what an earlier version made by these names, and CI installs the published 3.9.0 first and upgrades it | The identifier step, with the same upgrade test |
| User data | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChatMCP` (Hub state, logs, WebView2 data) | The history, key store and settings of every existing install are there | The identifier step, with a migration |
| Source tree | file names `chatmcp-*`, namespaces `ChatMCP.*`, environment variables `CHATMCP_*`, request headers `X-ChatMCP-*`, browser storage keys `chatmcp:*`, project files `.chatmcp/`, the health id `chatmcp-local-hub` | They are interfaces: scripts, stored data, the extension and other programs use them | The identifier step, one family at a time, each with an alias for the old name |
| What models are told | The system prompts and the text of the gateway and Gemini contracts ("You are the task agent in ChatMCP Hub") | They are instructions, not a display name; changing a word changes what a model is told and needs its own test | The next revision of the prompts |
| Tasks saved by an older Hub | A final text that ends `[Verification notice] ChatMCP has NOT independently verified ...` | It is stored data. The Hub reads both wordings and writes the new one | Stays |
| Developer tools | Git identities used by the coding agent (`ChatMCP Coding Agent`), the console banners of the test and smoke scripts, the old checkout installer `scripts/install-desktop.ps1` and `uninstall-desktop.ps1` (they make `ChatMCP Studio` shortcuts that point into a checkout, which setup leaves alone), comments in the code | Not shown to a person using the product | With the identifier step |
| Older things | The helper extension `ChatMCP Button Fix` (a different, older helper), the legacy pages `/classic` and `/legacy`, and the historical documents (`RELEASE-NOTES-*`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/PHASE*`, `docs/agent-handoffs/`) | They describe or belong to the past; history is not rewritten | The legacy pages are deleted in P8; the rest stays |

**Shortcuts of versions up to 3.10.1.** Those versions made the Desktop shortcut `ChatMCP Studio` and the Start menu folder `ChatMCP` with `ChatMCP Studio` and `Uninstall ChatMCP Studio`. Setup now makes `DatGold Studio` and the folder `DatGold`. When it installs over an earlier version it removes the old shortcuts that point into that installation, whichever shortcut choices the wizard shows (the machine then shows one name), and removes the folder `ChatMCP` only if nothing else is in it. The uninstaller removes both sets. A tile that a person pinned to the taskbar or to Start from an old shortcut keeps its old name until it is pinned again. The names setup looks for are `LegacyAppName` and `LegacyStartMenuFolder` in `installer/InstallerEngine.cs`; `scripts/tests/Test-NativeLifecycle.ps1` installs the published 3.9.0 and upgrades it to check the whole sequence.

Two phrases keep the old name on purpose because they describe a real folder: "the folder where ChatMCP is installed" (the Browser Companion instructions) and `cd ChatMCP` (the folder `git clone` makes). Both change with the folders.

## Checking

```
node DATGOLD-HUB/tests/verify-display-name.mjs
```

A new string, screen or document must say DatGold. If something truly has to keep the old spelling, add it to this table and to the `TECHNICAL` list in that test, with the reason.

| Thành phần | Mức độ |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | Bắt buộc cho native desktop |
| WebView2 Runtime | Bắt buộc để mở cửa sổ desktop |
| Git for Windows | Cần cho Git và parallel worktrees |
| Node.js 22.12+ | Cần khi chạy từ mã nguồn; bản installer đã bundle portable Node |
| Model provider | API key theo nhà cung cấp; hoặc Ollama/LM Studio tool-capable ở loopback |
| .NET SDK 10 | Chỉ khi build lại ChatMCP.exe / DatGoldSetup.exe |

cd ChatMCP

# git fetch origin
# git switch refactor/local-only-remove-cloud

~~~

## 3. Khởi động Hub

~~~powershell

# Hoặc mở native desktop

~~~
